title: Fix three bugs in Rust Option-chaining utility functions
description: Three Rust functions using Option have bugs: find_first returns last, safe_div returns None when divisor is non-zero, zip_with panics on None.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs:
1. `find_first`: change `v.last()` to `v.first()`
2. `safe_div`: swap the branches — `if b == 0 { None } else { Some(a / b) }`
3. `zip_with`: use `a.zip(b).map(|(x, y)| f(x, y))` instead of unwrap
All 4 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
